# rixl Provider

Terraform provider for managing Rixl platform resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    rixl = {
      source  = "rixlhq/rixl"
      version = ">= 0.0.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "rixl" {
  api_key = var.rixl_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Rixl API key used for the `X-API-Key` header. Can be set via the `RIXL_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Override the Rixl API base URL. Can be set via the `RIXL_BASE_URL` environment variable. Defaults to `https://api.rixl.com`.
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Rixl bearer token used for the `Authorization` header. Can be set via the `RIXL_BEARER_TOKEN` environment variable.
